observed_evidence.root_cause: Fire-and-forget browser batch was removed before database ACK; ingest could return 202 ok:true after 0 stored rows; retries were not idempotent. Stacked candidate initially lacked canonical money-page growth writer guard, enabling duplicate CTA signals.
observed_evidence.impact: Partial raw website events and behavioral-exit coverage unknown. Bots cannot be qualified leads. No causal experiment or paid order inferred.

remediation.implementation: Unique event_uid; database ACK before browser dequeue; 503 for degraded ingest; 422 for invalid/without-consent details; fixed-size unacknowledged-first browser queue, local overflow diagnostic; preserve single commercial writer and only in-main CTA; scoped read-only consented non-bot aggregate in existing Andere data.
remediation.privacy: Do not store field values, free text, personal URL queries, replay, or unauthorised tenant data. Behavioral details only with permission.
limitations: pagehide is best-effort, not complete capture
closed tab may lose pending sessionStorage events
local overflow count is not a server-confirmed event and must not be treated as full coverage
observed last section not true exit reason
remediation.owner: Existing website CRO / Powerhouse Recovery Writer; no additional scheduler or executor.

prevention_rules: Never delete any unacknowledged raw batch: require exact count/UID receipt after successful storage; test 503 and duplicate retry.
Queue saturation may discard only NEW events, never pending unacknowledged events; record overflow as data-quality failure.
Reject invalid/mixed consent batches rather than partially filter or return ok:true.
Keep one canonical CTA event producer; generated money pages are owner; skip duplicate sitewide bridge.
Only count consented non-bot behavior with source freshness and human session denominators; missing data must remain unknown.
Never promote CRO WINNER, lead or revenue without independent provider/outcome proof.
Required/CodeQL/BRAIN/System Map, DB schema, Edge, Netlify exact main and browser 2-tenant + UID readback before live closure.

production_readback: NOT_VERIFIED; require persisted event_uid readback after Edge and Netlify release

terminal_rule: CANDIDATE until protected merge, actual production migrations/Edge rollout, Netlify/browser/auth verification and persisted non-bot UID readback. Do not mark GREEN on code or tests alone.
